title: Cost of sequential query programs
statement: Let a deterministic query program return an output $x$ with cost $c$, and let a continuation assign a query program to each possible output. Running the program obtained by sequencing this continuation after the first program returns the continuation's output and has cost equal to $c$ plus the cost of running the continuation at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A continuation from outputs to query programs
